test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a type of social networking application?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haptik**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haptik** is not a type of social networking application.
 
• **LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter** are well-known social networking applications used for professional networking, social interaction, and microblogging, respectively.
 
• Haptik is primarily a conversational AI platform that allows businesses to build chatbots and virtual assistants, not a social networking platform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Social networking applications** are platforms that facilitate social interactions and networking among users through various communication tools like messaging, posting updates, and sharing content.
 
• Examples of popular social networking platforms include **Facebook** for social interaction, **LinkedIn** for professional networking, and **Twitter** for microblogging and real-time updates.
 
• **Haptik**, on the other hand, is used by businesses to enhance customer experience through automated communication and is not designed for social networking.
